name: @agentry/flow
description: Agentry's in-run orchestration MCP — schema-validated task lifecycle, event stream, review sidecar and content-hash over the .agentry/work/<run>/ files (text = truth, ADR-001), shipped as a committed zero-install bundle at plugin/flow/index.js.
comment:exports: Internal 'live-types' subpath exports (ADR-007): expose flow's source modules to in-repo workspace consumers (e.g. @agentry/workbench-*) so they import flow's domain shapes + computeVersion/render instead of redeclaring them. Source-pointing (.ts) because flow has no dist build — its own bundle is built from an explicit esbuild entryPoint, so this does NOT affect plugin/flow/index.js and does NOT touch src/, so dist-lockstep is unaffected.
